Preserve locally owned work across import, restore and update
One independent application underpins web and native distribution

nodes.label: Local-first shared study core
nodes.rationale: Static web, Electron and Capacitor bundle the same on-device document operations; hosted shells distribute code without receiving notes, ink or files. Ink uses unscaled pressure/timestamp points, new pressure-aware rounded segments preserve earlier samples, legacy strokes retain perfect-freehand outlines, and SVG/canvas/PDF share geometry.

nodes.label: Revision-checked IndexedDB persistence
nodes.rationale: Compare-and-swap transactions retain bounded checkpoints; serialized per-document writers coalesce edits, preserve dirty copies on failure and report Saved only after completion.

nodes.label: Validated additive portable backups
nodes.rationale: Schema, references and SHA-256 hashes are preflighted before atomic restore with fresh IDs; documents, preferences and original assets are preserved without replacing existing work.

nodes.label: Authoritative Markdown contract
nodes.rationale: Markdown text remains authoritative across modes. DOMPurify sanitizes the shared GFM, KaTeX and HTML renderer, including Obsidian-style callouts and highlights; executable URLs and remote embedded images are blocked while user-activated external links are allowed.

nodes.label: Offline shell and save-aware upgrades
nodes.rationale: Service-worker caches hold application assets only; explicit upgrade activation flushes edits first, and IndexedDB migrations are additive.

nodes.label: Independent static web application
nodes.rationale: Stable HTTPS or localhost origin and browser profile retain the workspace; changing either creates separate storage, and static hosting receives no document content.

nodes.label: Electron desktop shell
nodes.rationale: A fixed 127.0.0.1:47421 origin preserves IndexedDB; the isolated renderer has no general filesystem bridge, and normal close waits for saves or keeps the window open on failure. Current packaged Windows/Linux checks pass saving, relaunch, ink and backups; Linux used WSLg with its sandbox disabled only for the test.

nodes.label: Capacitor Android shell
nodes.rationale: Bundled assets use stable https://localhost without a service worker; cloud backup is disabled, Back/pause request saves, and process death cannot guarantee a flush. The current development-signed APK verifies assets/signature and compiles predictive Back; physical Android providers, gestures, stylus and keyboard checks remain open, and release-signed installations require the preserved release identity.

nodes.label: Android native Save export
nodes.rationale: A narrow plugin copies private export-cache files to ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT URIs in 64 KiB chunks; success follows stream closure, cancellation reports no success and concurrent copies are rejected.

nodes.label: Shared hidden-path visibility filter
nodes.rationale: Display names and slash/backslash paths are checked independently, including path ancestors with null parentId; hidden subtrees leave stored notes intact and stay out of navigation, search and link completion.

nodes.label: Android asset and signing verification
nodes.rationale: Build helpers rebuild/sync, compare all bundled files and verify signatures; release assembly requires the preserved certificate credentials, and debug signing cannot update an existing release installation.

nodes.label: MainActivity immersive inset ownership
nodes.rationale: Android publishes physical cutouts only, consumes system-bar padding and resizes for the keyboard once; disabling SystemBars inset handling prevents duplicate handlers. Native device behavior remains unverified.

nodes.label: Sanitized Obsidian-compatible Markdown rendering
nodes.rationale: Both preview modes support sanitized HTML, highlights, comments, callouts and local links/images; this does not establish compatibility with all Obsidian plugins or embedding syntax.

nodes.label: Restored document session
nodes.rationale: Persisted tab order and active document are restored before session saving begins, with the document URL synchronized so startup cannot overwrite the saved session.

nodes.label: Verified anonymous archive downloads
nodes.rationale: Historical 0.1.0 download bytes, SHA-256 hashes and ZIP integrity were checked independently of the hosted application's sign-in gate; packaging and installation do not establish all runtime workflows.

nodes.label: Safe physical file and folder moves
nodes.rationale: Moves preserve concurrent edits and cached IDs; browser copies verify hidden and binary entries before removing originals, Android requires provider move support, and collisions/descendant moves fail safely.
nodes.norm_label: safe physical file and folder moves

nodes.label: Recoverable folder Trash
nodes.rationale: Folder deletion moves its subtree into Slate Trash while retaining connected-vault originals; restore leaves documents previously trashed separately in Trash.

nodes.label: Focal-point notebook pinch rendering
nodes.rationale: One animation-frame transform follows a normalized paper point without React rerenders or canvas resizing; release commits layout/scroll and resizes once. Rendering checks do not measure physical-device frame rate.

nodes.label: Android predictive Back navigation
nodes.rationale: AndroidX progress/cancel/commit callbacks animate the document over an inert mounted library; cancellation retains the active note, and the ordinary Capacitor Back handler is disabled to avoid competing callbacks.

nodes.label: MathLive equation keyboard ownership
nodes.rationale: Externally attached keyboard and symbol-variant taps belong to the composer; measured keyboard height keeps actions reachable, dismissal hides the keyboard, and Android Back dispatches Escape without discarding cancelled drafts.

nodes.label: Historical Flexcil nested ZIP findings
nodes.rationale: Read-only inspection established unencrypted .flex containers and nested .flx ZIPs with PDF/JPEG/JSON and opaque payloads; one sampled document does not establish a universal schema.

nodes.label: Controlled Flexcil decoder fixtures
nodes.rationale: One-feature non-personal fixtures and structural diffs are required before editable-ink or audio-timeline claims; unknown payloads and provenance must survive unsupported decoding.

nodes.label: Flexcil audio recording and syncing documentation
nodes.rationale: Product-level annotation/audio linkage is documented; the inspected backup does not establish codecs, archive paths or timestamp mappings.
nodes.norm_label: flexcil audio recording and syncing documentation

nodes.label: Bounded seekable Flexcil importer
nodes.rationale: ZIP/ZIP64, CRC/path/encryption/size checks and one-document staging bound recovery: 20,000 entries, 16 MB directory, 256 MB .flx, 100 MB PDF, 4 MB JSON and 100:1 ratio; without OPFS, .flx is capped at 64 MB.

nodes.label: Immutable original Flexcil assets
nodes.rationale: Complete .flx assets remain exportable and included in backups; OPFS-backed sources are materialized before temporary-file deletion so cleanup cannot invalidate saved originals.

nodes.label: Scoped fingerprint duplicate prevention
nodes.rationale: Matching source-entry/fingerprint pairs are skipped within the workspace or vault to protect later Slate ink; cancellation stops before the next atomic commit, and differing exports are not fuzzily merged.

nodes.label: Unverified Flexcil object and audio decoding
nodes.rationale: No verified decoder exists for handwriting, objects, native/added/rearranged pages, templates or synchronized audio; original PDFs recover, otherwise blank placeholders and honest reports preserve recoverability.
nodes.norm_label: unverified flexcil object and audio decoding

nodes.label: Verified physical vault Rename
nodes.rationale: File/folder renames retain extensions, content, cached IDs and history, reject overwrites and verify browser copies before removing originals; Markdown link targets are not rewritten.

nodes.label: Markdown source and property fidelity
nodes.rationale: Opening/rendering/filtering never normalizes saved text; user edits retain CRLF, while exported bracketed tags and BOM/leading-whitespace YAML render with source offsets intact.

nodes.label: Shared drag lifecycle cleanup
nodes.rationale: Escape, drag end, outside drops, focus loss, page hiding and touch cancellation clear targets/listeners and restore the source so later moves remain usable.

nodes.label: Shared safe-area CSS contract
nodes.rationale: Four Capacitor --safe-area-inset-* variables fall back to browser env values; native-applied padding publishes zero and mobile bottom padding is applied once.

nodes.label: Unified editable Markdown heading
nodes.rationale: A leading ATX/Setext H1 merges with the filename; heading edits and source edits rename the physical vault file while preserving metadata, body, offsets, IDs, history and concurrent edits.

nodes.label: Bounded high-zoom notebook rendering
nodes.rationale: 50–500% zoom retains original page coordinates and reuses vector paths; drawing buffers stay near eight million pixels with a 4096px longest edge to bound memory.

nodes.label: Connected folder vault adapters
nodes.rationale: Desktop directory pickers, Android SAF and browser File System Access connect existing folders with write-through conflict checks and offline caches; backups add copies without reconnecting files, and imported caches do not synchronize between devices.

nodes.label: Universal line-number, Vim and layout preferences
nodes.rationale: Source/live/reading share saved line numbers and column layout; Vim number commands update that preference, and Android hardware-key detection leaves ordinary soft input alone.
nodes.norm_label: universal line-number, vim and layout preferences

nodes.label: Current delivery versus historical evidence
nodes.rationale: The opening record identifies 0.1.12 with passing Windows/Linux native checks; subsequent sections describe 0.1.0 and must not override newer evidence. Physical Android/stylus validation remains open.

nodes.label: Maintained application and legacy boundary
nodes.rationale: The maintained source/history and local legacy research remain separate; legacy UI and incompatible persistence/document models are reference material rather than an application merge target.

nodes.label: Preserved repository migration history
nodes.rationale: Complete private ZIP backup, original Git metadata and an old-to-new commit map preserve migration recovery; existing releases retain their bytes and checksums, and local retention folders are excluded from Git.

nodes.label: Direct pressure-aware ink segments
nodes.rationale: New strokes record coalesced/final-lift samples without reshaping earlier segments; the optional direct marker survives transforms/backups/exports while existing ink keeps its legacy renderer.

nodes.label: Pen, palm and two-finger arbitration
nodes.rationale: Pen input suppresses touching palms and pre-contact dots while intentional two-finger pan/pinch/undo remains available during hover; finger drawing stays optional.

nodes.label: Scoped browser and native validation evidence
nodes.rationale: Synthetic Chromium touch/pen and Android keyboard events validate application behavior; isolated Windows native checks verify saves/vaults, while this dated run does not establish physical Android providers, stylus latency or new Linux runtime evidence.
nodes.norm_label: scoped browser and native validation evidence

nodes.label: vaultMissing reconciliation and startup refresh
nodes.rationale: Only successful scans mark absent physical paths missing; caches/history, hidden exclusions and source-less records remain intact, returning paths reuse IDs, and startup refresh precedes tabs. Running changes require refresh/restart; no watcher exists.

nodes.label: Windows and Linux CI
nodes.rationale: Checks pushes to main, pull requests and manual runs with read-only repository permissions, cancellable per-ref concurrency and a non-fail-fast OS matrix.

nodes.label: Library and tag refinement review
nodes.rationale: Existing tokens, paper and controls are retained. Keyboard and 44px touch alternatives support organization without introducing canvas long-press gestures that interfere with ink. Browser evidence does not establish physical Android or Linux runtime behavior.

nodes.label: Incremental workspace refinement review
nodes.rationale: Preserves the incumbent design and Markdown authority; math and PDF modules load on demand while ink stays on the direct canvas path. Browser/source evidence leaves physical native input coverage and main-bundle size unresolved.

nodes.label: Scoped visual release review
nodes.rationale: Approves the installable web surface from production captures and source; the later packaged Linux capture extends visual evidence only. Missing approved comps, physical-device results and independent benchmarks are not invented.

nodes.label: Maintained root application direction
nodes.rationale: The repository root is the sole maintained application; ignored .local legacy research is not a UI development target. Preserve the offline data contract and keep Windows, Linux, Android and independent web behavior aligned.

nodes.label: Contribution and validation contract
nodes.rationale: Use Node.js 22+ and Bun 1.4.2 from the repository root. Synthetic fixtures and isolated profiles protect user notes, vault identities, originals and Android signing identity; native changes require platform-specific verification.

nodes.label: Slate visual system
nodes.rationale: The binding open-study-desk identity uses cool neutrals, slate-blue interaction ink, quiet separators, square pages and compact floating tools.

nodes.label: Slate product contract
nodes.rationale: A study workspace combines Markdown knowledge work, paged handwriting, PDF annotation and DOCX reading. Creation has Markdown and Notebook choices. Accounts, cloud sync, AI, collaboration, OCR, recognition and a plugin marketplace are outside the product.

nodes.label: Slate project memory
nodes.rationale: Records root source ownership, persistent user preferences, cross-platform deliveries and source-preserving migration constraints. Saved Quick notes remain ordinary documents even when their creation/navigation entry is removed.

nodes.label: Repository and distribution overview
nodes.rationale: src/slate contains the shared application; platform contains packaging helpers, android the Capacitor project, tests validation, public local assets, packages workspace dependencies and docs architecture/research.

nodes.label: Open study desk design brief
nodes.rationale: Operate with Read inside documents: a quiet course library yields to a document while keeping context reachable. Use real content, restrained state transitions and no decorative marketing surfaces or forced onboarding.

nodes.label: Android update identity
nodes.rationale: Retain app.slate.workspace, the HTTPS localhost origin and the RSA 4096 release signing identity; increment versionCode. Matching identity permits updates while preserving the installation's private workspace. Debug builds cannot update release-signed installations.

nodes.label: Windows icon provenance
nodes.rationale: slate.ico is a standard-size format conversion of the authored public/icons/slate-512.png mark; no new visual asset was generated.

nodes.label: File-based routing contract
nodes.rationale: TanStack Start treats .tsx files in src/routes as routes; routeTree.gen.ts is generated. Next.js/Remix layout conventions and manual generated-tree edits are forbidden.

nodes.label: Cross-platform production validation pipeline
nodes.rationale: Bun 1.4.2 installs the frozen lockfile, then runs typecheck, scoped lint, unit tests, standalone build, Chromium installation and production browser tests on Ubuntu and Windows.

nodes.label: Shared offline application
nodes.rationale: React 19/TypeScript, CodeMirror 6, IndexedDB, Canvas 2D, PDF.js, Mammoth and a local math field serve Electron Windows/Linux, Capacitor Android and independent web from one application.

nodes.label: Offline local ownership and recoverability
nodes.rationale: No account or internet connection is needed after installation; keeping study data locally gives the owner control and recovery without cloud services.

nodes.label: Markdown source authority
nodes.rationale: Source, live preview and reading share authoritative Markdown rather than introducing a competing document model; imported PDF and DOCX originals are preserved.

nodes.label: Source-preserving Flexcil migration
nodes.rationale: Preserve original imports and recover PDFs; handwriting/object payloads and synchronized audio lack a verified decoder, so editable handwriting or synchronized audio fidelity must not be claimed.

nodes.label: Theme-independent physical paper
nodes.rationale: Workspace themes distinguish interface surfaces while notebook paper retains its own appearance and square corners; source-coordinate page dimensions scale to the viewport.

nodes.label: Self-hosted Slate typography
nodes.rationale: DM Sans serves interface and headings, Source Serif 4 sustained reading, and genuine monospace source/code. Reading size responds to saved preferences.

nodes.label: Adaptive context and reading layout
nodes.rationale: Keep course, tabs and connections reachable: desktop uses a rail, narrow views temporary context and phones drawer/bottom destinations. Saved width, margins and placement apply across Markdown modes.

nodes.label: Touch and direct-ink interaction contract
nodes.rationale: Recorded pressure-aware samples never reshape earlier segments; legacy ink retains its rendering. Interface transitions honor reduced motion and never animate ink. Swipes avoid OS Back edges, menus provide alternatives, touch targets reach 44px and persistent side handles are forbidden.

nodes.label: Connected-vault identity and data integrity
nodes.rationale: Write through to selected folders using stable cached IDs; serialized rename/move operations protect simultaneous edits. Browser renames verify copies, including hidden/binary assets, before removing originals. Successful scans hide missing paths without deleting cached content/history; failed or hidden-path scans preserve data.

nodes.label: Materialize temporary OPFS imports before removal
nodes.rationale: An IndexedDB File snapshot can retain its temporary OPFS backing file and become unreadable when that file is deleted; materialize preserved sources before removing staging files.
nodes.norm_label: materialize temporary opfs imports before removal

nodes.label: Stable workspace storage identity
nodes.rationale: Notes, preferences, history and original imports belong to device profiles: %APPDATA%/Slate, normally ~/.config/Slate, the Android installation, or an exact browser origin/profile. Retaining these identities preserves work across updates.

nodes.label: Validated portable Slate backups
nodes.rationale: Settings exports .slate.zip backups; restore validates hashes and adds copies while preserving existing documents. Export before uninstalling or clearing application data.

nodes.label: Independent cached web distribution
nodes.rationale: build:standalone emits dist/standalone, served over HTTPS or a stable localhost origin. The cached application shell works offline after its first load; the optional hosted build remains separate.

nodes.label: Source, staging and completed release layout
nodes.rationale: Develop at the repository root; artifacts stages builds and releases/<date-description> holds runnable deliveries. Generated packages are ignored by Git and distributed through GitHub Releases; dependencies, local archives and private credentials stay out of source control.
nodes.norm_label: source, staging and completed release layout

nodes.label: Encrypted Android signing credential safeguards
nodes.rationale: An authenticated AES-256-GCM/scrypt envelope protects the PKCS12 keystore. Keep the private recovery password outside Git, archives and APKs; losing it prevents updates under the preserved release identity. Never discard a workspace to resolve a debug/release signature mismatch.

nodes.label: Verified Android release build pipeline
nodes.rationale: The helper authenticates/decrypts into a private temporary directory, typechecks, rebuilds standalone web, syncs Capacitor, signs and verifies certificate/signature/bundled files. Temporary key material is removed even on failure; Gradle gets secrets through the environment and rejects unsigned release tasks.

nodes.label: src/routes/__root.tsx application layout
nodes.rationale: The sole routed app shell wraps every page and must preserve Outlet; independent web has its own HTML entry.

nodes.label: src/standalone-entry.tsx entry point
nodes.rationale: The HTML root container is bootstrapped by this module script.

nodes.label: Independent web content security policy
nodes.rationale: Limits resources and connections to self plus declared data/blob and wasm/style allowances, blocks object loading and base URI changes, and loads a local icon and web manifest.
